title: Weapon Feel
description: A firing range for judging how the Static Pulse feels to fire: the game's own weapon against one fixed target, under the baseline and three firing-feedback treatments. Same damage, same rate of fire, no enemies. Keys 1-4 switch treatments in play. Offline: nothing of yours is saved or changed.
limitations: Only the feedback differs: recoil and recovery, the muzzle, the firing sound, the impact and the hit confirmation. Damage (6 a hit) and the rate of fire (one shot per 0.35 s) are the game's, unchanged.
The target is the Echo Lab's dummy: it takes and counts damage and never dies, so there is no kill confirmation to compare.
Sounds are new recipes in the game's existing procedural bank; no recorded audio.

modes.label: Weapon Feel, Baseline
modes.description: Starts in the baseline: the Static Pulse exactly as it ships.

modes.label: Weapon Feel, A Heavy report
modes.description: Starts in treatment A: a big, slow-settling kick, a warm fireball flash, a low boom, sparks and a chunky hit marker.

modes.label: Weapon Feel, B Crisp snap
modes.description: Starts in treatment B: a short, sharp kick back in 0.08 s, a cold white snap, a bright crack and a crisp tick.

modes.label: Weapon Feel, C Echo resonance
modes.description: Starts in treatment C: a medium kick, a cyan ring and a flash that flares twice, a shot that echoes, an impact ring and a delayed chime.
